decisive_feature: prescription medicine bought from a retailer with no pharmacy registration, no prescription supplied, irreversible after dispatch
why: The retailer has no pharmacy-register match, the dispensing pharmacy is unnamed, the prescription is only 'may' be checked, and substitutes may be sent, so a non-returnable prescription drug of uncertain origin could reach a patient. That medication-safety risk outweighs the small, user-authorized payment and lifts the case to moderate.
